Our task is to find A, B and C such that

37−19x(3x+1)(x−4)(3−x)=A(3x+1)+B(x−4)+C(3−x).

Multiplying both sides by (3x+1)(x−4)(3−x) gives

37−19x=A(x−4)(3−x)+B(3x+1)(3−x)+C(3x+1)(x−4).

For x=−13, we get 37−19(−13)=A(−13−4)(3−(−13))=+B(3(−13)+1)(3−(−13))=+C(3(−13)+1)(−13−4)37+193=A(−1309)1303=A(−1309)A=−3.

For x=4, we get 37−19(4)=A(4−4)(3−4)=+B(3(4)+1)(3−4)=+C(3(4)+1)(x−4)37−76=B(−13)B=−39−13B=3.

For x=3, we get 37−19(3)=A(3−4)(3−3)=+B(3(3)+1)(3−3)=+C(3(3)+1)(3−4)37−57=C(−10)C=−20−10C=2. Hence, 37−19x(3x+1)(x−4)(3−x)=−3(3x+1)+3(x−4)+2(3−x).
